newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine oil firm seeks partner to run tankers.
newsitem.headline: Philippine oil firm seeks partner to run tankers.

text.p: The PNOC Shipping & Transport Corp, the transportation unit of state-owned Philippine National Oil Co (PNOC), said on Monday it is seeking a joint venture partner to operate its nine oil tankers and one tugboat.
The nine tankers and the tugboat represent the core fleet of the company. PNOC Shipping said it planned to set up a joint venture company where the winning bidder would hold 60 percent interest.
Aside from the nine tankers and a tugboat, the winning bidder would also hold full control on the operation of a chartered tanker.
PNOC bidding committee chairman Cecilio Penson said PNOC had pegged the indicative price at 355 million pesos.
The deadline to submit pre-qualification documents is set on March 5, while final bids should be in by March 31.
